rules.title: Assembly Bill 12 (California security deposit limits)
rules.requirement: Starting July 1, 2024, landlords may generally charge a security deposit of no more than one month's rent for furnished or unfurnished units. Small landlords (two properties, no more than four units total, owned by a natural person, family trust or all-natural-person LLC) may charge up to two months' rent. Deposits must be returned within 21 days with an itemized statement, and photo and walk-through duties apply.
rules.key_value: 1 month's rent (2 months for small landlords) from 2024-07-01; return within 21 days

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental tenancies in California.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Small landlords with two properties and no more than four units total may charge up to two months' rent.

rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance security deposit interest requirement
rules.requirement: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year. A prorated amount is due if the tenant moves out before year end.
